contract: For the selected elementary PID, supply each complete transport payload to the standalone PES assembler with its PUSI and physical offset. Poll with one, seven, 184 or 4096 work units. Ordinary entity boundaries retain assembly.

The packet fold uses the returned original stream ID, raw PTS and DTS in period zero, first header carrier position and all payload bytes. Raw header fields, partial headers and source ranges are also emitted in trace mode. The reference exposes the packet fold.

The pinned formats worker opens the selected program with public MPEG-TS AVIO, NOPARSE and NOFILLIN, without stream discovery. It delivers ordinary entities in one AVIO source and flushes at a declared discontinuity.

The packet fold is the mpegts-pes fold: stream index, PID, PTS and DTS in 90 kHz ticks (INT64_MIN for absence), duration, position, flags, size, bytes and every side-data element. Input loading is outside the run. Both sides drain the last entity to logical end.
Every operation in the mpegts-pes corpus runs for each form, retaining its 272 request mappings and the hash of every ordered input.

Candidate header and payload source ranges are checked against the preloaded entity bytes. At each carrier boundary cutting a syntactically admitted PES header, check every retained partial header byte against the carrier prefix under H.222.0 §2.4.3.6. The four work grants use the corpus that splits the header after every byte. Trace the public header flags.
The source-clocks profile uses the public demux clock reduced to 33 bits, encoded timestamp presence from the PES start on the original carrier grid, and the physical start carrier offset for M2TS.

open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.3: one consecutive identical copy on the same PID is permitted, with PCR the only permitted byte change.
open_deviations.candidate: Drops the legal duplicate, preserving each original PES payload and position.
open_deviations.reference: Repeats the PES or includes duplicate elementary bytes, sometimes splitting the PES.

open_deviations.reading: A third copy is a continuity fault
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.3 permits only two consecutive identical packets of the same PID.
open_deviations.candidate: Discards the excess copy and the pending assembly it interrupts. An already published PES stays delivered, and the next admissible start can resume assembly.
open_deviations.reference: Delivers payload from excess copies or merges it into the affected PES.

open_deviations.reading: Missing transport continuity breaks pending PES assembly
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §§2.4.3.3 and 2.4.3.6 define continuity on each PID and the declared PES extent.
open_deviations.candidate: Drops the affected partial PES and publishes the next complete packet if present.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes the available bytes with the corrupt flag and continues on the next start if present.

open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.5 defines PCR extension as the system-clock count modulo 300.
open_deviations.candidate: Rejects the affected carrier and emits no PES from it.
open_deviations.reference: Returns the 27-byte PES payload at PTS 90000.

open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.5 permits OPCR only in a transport packet containing PCR.
open_deviations.candidate: Rejects the carrier with unpaired OPCR and publishes no PES on this input.

open_deviations.reading: Transport error indication marks untrustworthy payload
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.3 defines TEI as at least one uncorrectable error in the transport packet.
open_deviations.candidate: Does not publish a PES from the errored carrier.
open_deviations.reference: Returns 27 bytes at PTS 90000 without a corrupt flag.

open_deviations.reading: User-defined scrambling flag requires an interpretation before clear payload delivery
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.3 Table 2-4 distinguishes scrambling from clear payload.
open_deviations.candidate: Does not publish a PES from the scrambled carrier.
open_deviations.reference: Returns the 27 bytes and PTS 90000 as a packet.

open_deviations.reading: A zero PTS marker bit violates the PES header grammar
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §§2.4.3.6–2.4.3.7 Table 2-21 requires the timestamp marker bits.
open_deviations.candidate: Rejects the malformed header and emits no PES.
open_deviations.reference: Returns 27 bytes with PTS and DTS 90000.

open_deviations.reading: PES timestamp flag value 01 is forbidden
open_deviations.candidate: Rejects the malformed header and emits no PES.
open_deviations.reference: Returns 27 bytes with both clocks absent.

open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.7 gives the number of bytes after PES_packet_length.
open_deviations.reference: Emits the 24 available payload bytes with the corrupt flag.

open_deviations.reading: An audio PES declares an unbounded length
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.7 allows zero PES_packet_length only for video elementary payload in TS.

open_deviations.reading: Continuation payload exceeds the finite PES extent
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §§2.4.3.3 and 2.4.3.7 define one PES start per PUSI carrier and the length through the last PES byte.
open_deviations.candidate: Does not publish the PES when a carrier supplies extra payload past its declared extent.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes a 27-byte declared prefix or returns 401–415 bytes in split PES packets.
